item.title: Bulletin updated at 18:50 HKT 02/Mar/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of an easterly airstream, it will be relatively warm and humid over the coast of Guangdong in the next few days with some mist in the morning and at night. The northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China next Monday, there will be a few rain patches over the region. A dry continental airstream will bring cooler and fine weather to the region in the following couple of days.

Date/Month: 03/03 (Thursday)
Wind: East force 3 to 4, force 5 offshore at first.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with sunny intervals. Mist patches at first.
Temp range: 18 - 23 C
R.H. range: 70 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low
